sources.summary: Dezeen has announced the architecture shortlist for this year's Dezeen Awards, which includes buildings by Dorte Mandrup, Farshid Moussavi Architects and Herzog & de Meuron. The 152 shortlisted projects, which are in the running for awards in 19 different architecture project categories, are by studios located across 36 different countries, including China, Finland, Kuwait, Portugal, The post Dezeen Awards 2026 architecture shortlist announced appeared first on Dezeen .
